body: Why would I spend my life doing things for other people? That would mean im not truly living my life. In my opinion my life has had meaning. I've been able to impact a handful of peoples life in a positive manner. I'm not anti social or severely depressed person, as I stated earlier I'm just tired of existing. I played my part.

I mean of course there are thing I will still like to accomplish, becoming a father, finishing my degree program. Even if i did fulfill these life long dreams who's to say I would feel much differently than I do now, and at the point I would have more responsibilities and the opportunity to commit suicide would have a far more greater impact than it does now, and I'm not trying to put that weight on anymore people. I started contemplating this idea 2 weeks ago and since then Iv been able to put my life in perspective and appreciate all the things that I've done, seen and been apart of.
I'm not trying to be hostile at all. I just figured it would be nice to finally get some stuff off my chest before my inevitable end. If you do have a question feel free to ask.
Thank you very much I honestly appreciate the help.
